summary: Genome sizes are fully covered by the NCBI Datasets API (169,434 complete bacterial genomes; M. genitalium 580 kb), BioNumbers gives cited constants for the smallest cell diameter (0.2-0.3 µm) and molecular sizes, and BacDive exposes a per-strain Morphology section via an unauthenticated API, but cell dimensions were empty in the Mollicutes records sampled and no repository table of cell volume vs genome size for ultrasmall or CPR/DPANN organisms was found.
next_step: Export BacDive advanced search on cell_length/cell_width for all strains and join to NCBI genome lengths by tax id; add CPR/DPANN cell-volume measurements from cryo-TEM papers (e.g. Luef et al. 2015) by hand, since they are not in any repository found.
obstacles_confirmed: Culture collections miss many of the smallest uncultured cells.
Dependence on hosts blurs the definition of organism and minimum autonomous machinery.
